productContext.category: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway observability and operations workspace
productContext.designIntent: A trustworthy, dense operational workbench where signal, evidence, and in-context action take priority over decoration.

backgroundComposition.boundary: Ambient layers belong to the application background only. Do not add floating decorative blobs, gradient text, or content-area glow.

runtimeColorTokens.scope: CSS theme tokens implemented in web/src/index.css but not represented by DESIGN.md frontmatter.

semanticColorContract.primary: Current selection, primary action, focus ring, and key request signal only.
semanticColorContract.foregroundRule: Use *-content tokens on solid or high-fill semantic surfaces. Use shared tone-ink tokens for semantic text on translucent or neutral surfaces.
semanticColorContract.nonColorRequirement: Status must also be conveyed through text, value, icon, shape, legend, or label.

typographyMeta.fontStack: IBM Plex Sans, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

display.purpose: Application brand, page title, or high-level drawer title; never a marketing hero.

headline.purpose: Section, important panel, and dialog headings.

title.purpose: Card titles, form groups, and primary list labels.

body.purpose: Descriptions, table content, and configuration context.

label.purpose: Short table headers, field labels, and metric labels.

surfaceMeta.surface-panel: Application-level container that separates a major page region from the background.
surfaceMeta.surface-card: Default restrained card surface with tonal background, subtle border, and light or no shadow.
surfaceMeta.surface-subtle: Rows, list items, chip groups, and secondary blocks inside a card.
surfaceMeta.surface-inset: Configuration groups and recessed internal sections.
surfaceMeta.menu-surface: Select, menu, and popover list surface.
surfaceMeta.dialog-chrome-surface: Sticky dialog or drawer header and footer only.
surfaceMeta.rule: Prefer shared surface classes. Do not recreate default containers from page-local border and translucent background utilities.

elevation.rule: Static content uses tonal layering and restrained borders. Strong shadow is reserved for panels and overlays.

compact.navigation: Use one hamburger navigation layer containing top-level and Account Pool/System destinations.
compact.dialogs: Use a bottom sheet with safe-area padding, 100dvh constraints, and one content scroll body.
compact.details: Page heavy account and Prompt Cache details; use full-height bottom sheets for remaining overlays.
compact.content: Stack filters and metrics, prefer readable mobile structures, and avoid body-level horizontal overflow.

desktop.navigation: Use the horizontal top-level segmented navigation and workspace-local secondary navigation.
desktop.dialogs: Use centered dialogs and right-side drawers according to context.

rules: Transition color and shadow properties; do not animate layout properties.
Use short fade, zoom, slide, pulse, or spin feedback only when it explains state.
Do not use choreographed page-entry animation.

requirements: Keyboard-reachable controls and visible focus rings.
Readable aria-labels and stable heading and landmark structure.
Text and semantic-state contrast in both light and dark themes.
Non-color status cues and accessible chart labels, legends, values, or tooltips.
Stable dimensions for loading, empty, error, and live-refresh states.
Safe-area-aware compact overlays and practical touch targets.

button.notes: Use icon-only buttons for familiar tools with an accessible label. Evaluate 44px targets in touch-first contexts.

chip.notes: Use explicit surface, border, and hue-bearing ink tokens in both themes; selected and interactive states also change border and weight.

model-identity.notes: Read-only identity hints preserve the complete model id in title and accessible name; unknown ids remain text.

segmented-control.notes: Desktop top-level navigation and content switching share one visual family.

field.notes: Error and disabled states require explicit feedback, not border color alone.

dialog-and-drawer.notes: Headers and actions may be sticky; the body owns the single scroll region.

chart.notes: Loading, empty, and error states preserve chart dimensions. Numeric axes and values remain stable and scannable.

dos: Reuse semantic OKLCH tokens and shared surface vocabulary.
Keep primary scarce and attach every color to an interaction, metric, or status meaning.
Use stable numeric alignment and preserve context during filtering, inspection, and editing.
Treat light, dark, desktop, and compact layouts as first-class states.
Use Storybook and the mock-only Web Demo as stable review surfaces.
donts: Do not use gradient text, thick colored side rails, or decorative content-area blobs.
Do not make glassmorphism the default container language.
Do not reproduce generic SaaS hero-metric card grids.
Do not rely on neon dark-blue styling to communicate observability.
Do not solve density by shrinking readable text or practical touch targets.
Do not hard-code page-local colors when an existing semantic or chart token applies.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact, high-confidence command for a primary operational action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 2.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(var(--color-primary)); color: oklch(var(--color-primary-content)); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 IBM Plex Sans, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(var(--color-primary) / 0.9); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(var(--color-primary)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: oklch(var(--color-primary) / 0.82); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet companion action that stays legible in a dense workbench.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 2.25rem; border: 1px solid oklch(var(--color-base-300)); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(var(--color-base-200)); color: oklch(var(--color-base-content)); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 IBM Plex Sans, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: oklch(var(--color-base-300)); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(var(--color-primary)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A stable editable surface with a clear focus signal and restrained border.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field">Display name</label><input id="ds-field" class="ds-field" value="relay-west" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; color: oklch(var(--color-base-content) / 0.68); font: 600 0.75rem/1.35 IBM Plex Sans, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-field { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--field-surface-border, oklch(var(--color-base-300))); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--field-surface-bg, oklch(var(--color-base-100))); color: oklch(var(--color-base-content)); padding: 0 0.75rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25 IBM Plex Sans, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field:focus { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(var(--color-primary)); }

components.name: Segmented Navigation
components.description: The shared navigation and view-switching family for desktop operational context.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid oklch(var(--color-base-300) / 0.85); border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(var(--color-base-100) / 0.7); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, oklch(var(--color-base-content)) 8%, transparent), 0 2px 8px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(var(--color-neutral)) 8%, transparent); } .ds-segment { min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: oklch(var(--color-base-content) / 0.6); padding: 0 0.875rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 IBM Plex Sans, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-segment:hover { border-color: oklch(var(--color-base-300) / 0.8); background: oklch(var(--color-base-200) / 0.75); color: oklch(var(--color-base-content) / 0.9); } .ds-segment-active { border-color: oklch(var(--color-primary) / 0.45); background: oklch(var(--color-primary) / 0.2); color: oklch(var(--color-primary)); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(var(--color-primary)) 42%, transparent), 0 10px 18px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(var(--color-primary)) 24%, transparent); } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(var(--color-primary)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Semantic Chip
components.description: The shared status and filter surface with explicit semantic or categorical tone tokens.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--chip-warning-border); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--chip-warning-surface); color: var(--chip-warning-ink); padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; font: 500 0.75rem/1.35 IBM Plex Sans, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(var(--color-primary)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-warning { --chip-surface: var(--chip-warning-surface); --chip-border: var(--chip-warning-border); --chip-ink: var(--chip-warning-ink); }

components.name: GPT-6 Model Identity
components.description: A read-only, accessible model identity marker that changes presentation without changing the model text.
components.css: .ds-model-identity { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--model-identity-gpt6-border); border-radius: 0.3125rem; background: var(--model-identity-gpt6-tile); color: var(--model-identity-gpt6-astra-ink); } .ds-model-identity svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; } .ds-model-identity[data-model-variant="sol"] { color: var(--model-identity-gpt6-sol-ink); } .ds-model-identity[data-model-variant="luna"] { color: var(--model-identity-gpt6-luna-ink); } .ds-model-identity[data-model-presentation="embedded"] { border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A restrained evidence surface for dense metrics, lists, and settings groups.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--surface-card-border, oklch(var(--color-base-300) / 0.55)); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--surface-card-bg, oklch(var(--color-base-100))); box-shadow: var(--surface-card-shadow, 0 10px 24px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(var(--color-neutral)) 7%, transparent)); color: oklch(var(--color-base-content)); padding: 1.25rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 IBM Plex Sans, Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-card span { color: oklch(var(--color-base-content) / 0.7); }

narrative.overview: Codex Vibe Monitor is a dense, trustworthy operational workbench. It uses stable alignment, tonal layering, and restrained state color so operators can read live signals, trace evidence, and act without visual noise.

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Primary is reserved for the current selection, primary action, focus ring, and key running signal.

rules.name: Color Carries Meaning
rules.body: Count is blue, cost is amber, token volume is teal, success is green, and failure is red across the workspace.

rules.name: Dense Reading
rules.body: Density comes from alignment, grouping, and stable type, never from shrinking readable content.

rules.name: Flat By Default
rules.body: Static content relies on tonal layering and restrained borders; shadows are reserved for panels and overlays.

dos: Reuse semantic OKLCH tokens and shared surface vocabulary.
Keep primary scarce and bind every color to a state, metric, or interaction.
Use stable numeric alignment and preserve evidence context.
Treat light, dark, desktop, and compact layouts as first-class states.
Use the shared Chip entrypoint and preserve full model ids in identity tooltips and accessible names.
Use Storybook and the mock-only Web Demo as stable review surfaces.
donts: Do not use gradient text, thick colored side rails, or decorative content-area blobs.
Do not make glassmorphism the default container language.
Do not reproduce generic SaaS hero-metric card grids.
Do not rely on neon dark-blue styling to communicate observability.
Do not solve density by shrinking readable text or practical touch targets.
Do not keep page-private badge entrypoints or infer identity icons for unknown model names.
Do not hard-code page-local colors when an existing semantic or chart token applies.
